raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Runs DSpark's sequential Markov sampling for DeepSeek-V4.1 on NVIDIA as the existing bias GEMM plus two Triton kernels per draft step, through the draft model's `sample_sequential` hook (as the ROCm model does). Sampled draft tokens are drawn by inverse CDF of the cached draft logits instead of Gumbel-max. Production code changes only under `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/` (+223). It is opt-in: `--additional-config '{"dspark_fused_markov": true}'` enables it, and the speculator's loop stays the default.

## Claims

- DSpark Markov sampling (5 draft steps, GB200, CUDA graph): 1.6x at 1 request per rank, 2.7x to 3.9x at 16 to 253 requests per rank.
- DEP4 decode serving with AgentX KV: step time -1.7% at 64 requests x 131K context per rank, -3.2% at 128 x 32K.
- GSM8K and DSpark acceptance length unchanged at DEP4 and TEP4 (TP4 + EP).

## Validation

Kernel time, `DSparkSpeculator._sample_sequential` (main's loop) vs this PR, CUPTI under a CUDA graph, one GB200, V = 129280, rank 256, 5 draft steps, 3 runs each (spread under 1% except 1 request):

| Requests per rank | main loop (us), T=1 | This PR (us), T=1 | Speedup | main loop (us), T=0/0.6/1 mixed | This PR (us), mixed | Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 111.9 | 71.6 | 1.56x | 107.7 | 64.5 | 1.67x |
| 16 | 237.6 | 89.3 | 2.66x | 233.6 | 88.7 | 2.63x |
| 32 | 269.9 | 96.2 | 2.80x | 256.7 | 95.9 | 2.68x |
| 64 | 411.4 | 144.3 | 2.85x | 385.2 | 144.7 | 2.66x |
| 128 | 658.3 | 194.9 | 3.38x | 601.2 | 196.5 | 3.06x |
| 253 | 1158.5 | 298.9 | 3.88x | 1039.9 | 298.4 | 3.48x |

Re-checked on main `51c6dfd8c8` with this revision, same benchmark, one GPU, median of 3 alternating rounds (worst spread 9.0% at 1 request, 3.8% or less from 16 to 253 requests at T=1, 7.1% or less for mixed):

| Requests per rank | main loop (us), T=1 | This PR (us), T=1 | Speedup | main loop (us), mixed | This PR (us), mixed | Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 112.9 | 71.0 | 1.59x | 107.1 | 65.7 | 1.63x |
| 16 | 238.0 | 89.3 | 2.66x | 231.3 | 87.7 | 2.64x |
| 64 | 411.6 | 144.4 | 2.85x | 384.5 | 144.2 | 2.67x |
| 128 | 658.7 | 196.2 | 3.36x | 600.7 | 197.3 | 3.05x |
| 253 | 1158.7 | 301.3 | 3.85x | 1042.5 | 299.9 | 3.48x |

DEP4 decode serving, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on one GB200 node, DSpark K=5 probabilistic drafting, synthetic acceptance length 3.51, FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs, MegaAttn + MegaMoE, `--max-num-seqs 128`. The client fills the KV with AgentX token streams, then runs 6 rounds of 4096 forced output tokens with exactly the given requests on every rank (no logits processing, as AgentX); step time is the median of the last 3 rounds, measured only over windows of pure decode:

| Requests x context per rank | main (ms/step) | This PR (ms/step) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 64 x 131K | 25.26 | 24.84 | -1.7% |
| 128 x 32K | 34.17 | 33.08 | -3.2% |

Accuracy (`vllm serve`, DSpark K=5, probabilistic drafting, standard rejection sampling; GSM8K is lm_eval 5-shot, greedy, max 1024 tokens, concurrency 32; acceptance length from the server's spec-decode metrics over the GSM8K run):

| | GSM8K strict-match | Acceptance length |
|---|---|---|
| DEP4, reference (#62359's run, same flags) | 0.9265 | 3.451 |
| DEP4, this PR | 0.9280 | 3.448 |
| TEP4 (TP4 + EP), this PR | 0.9257 | 3.463 |

These evals and the DEP4 decode serving numbers ran on an earlier base (`66875d3127`, 259 commits behind `51c6dfd8c8`) and were not rerun. Since then this PR's kernels have not changed and the only production additions are the opt-in `dspark_fused_markov` check and one inlined local. All "This PR" numbers are the fused path, which now needs that flag. The speculator changed on main; I checked its `sample_sequential` contract by reading the code, and on the merged tree ran the test below and the kernel benchmark above.

The DEP4 eval ran with `--jit-monitor-verbose`: the new kernels compile only during warmup. The TEP4 eval ran with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/test_fused_markov.py -v  # 2 passed on main 51c6dfd8c8
```

The test runs the speculator's loop and the fused path on the same inputs: temperature-0 tokens and every cached logit of temperature-0 requests (and step 0 of all requests) match bit for bit, and sampled tokens follow softmax(cached logits / temperature).

## Details

- Per draft step, the loop runs the Markov embedding, the bias GEMM, the logits add, the Gumbel sample (its kernel, a cross-block argmax and a gather) and a copy into `draft_tokens`. Here the bias GEMM (cuBLAS) is kept, `_markov_sample_kernel` adds the base logits as the loop does (fp32 sum rounded once to the cache dtype), writes the draft-logits cache and keeps each vocab block's max and exp-sum, and `_markov_select_kernel` picks the token and writes its `markov_w1` row into the next step's GEMM input.
- Inverse CDF instead of Gumbel-max: one uniform per request, keyed by seed, draft step and position like the loop's noise, picks a block by the prefix sum of the block masses and a token inside it from the same fp32 weights. Tokens follow softmax(cached logits / T), the distribution the rejection sampler verifies; it costs one exp per logit instead of a hash and two logs, which made the Gumbel kernel ALU-bound. The sampled tokens are therefore not those of the loop's Gumbel draw; temperature-0 tokens are.
- The hook is set at model init only when `dspark_fused_markov` is true and the loop would sample from a full draft-logits cache with plain fp32 Gumbel noise: probabilistic drafting, no adaptive verification, no fp64 Gumbel, no watermarking and no batch-sharded sampling (whose sharded cache keeps the loop). Draft top-k is handled by the speculator before the hook.
- Not a duplicate of: #61869 (fuses the loop only with `decode_backend=latency_specialized` on GB300 TP), #64033 (the top-k Markov walk), #62958 (int8 `markov_w2` on Hopper), #63181 / #63891 and the merged #60731 (ROCm).

---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1's fused DSpark Markov sampling against DSparkSpeculator's loop:
+greedy tokens and the cached logits match, sampled tokens follow the softmax."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA only")
+
+VOCAB, RANK, N_SPEC, REQS = 129280, 256, 5, 64
+
+
+def _sample(fused: bool, temps: torch.Tensor, base: torch.Tensor, seed: int):
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops.fused_markov import FusedMarkovSampler
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dspark.speculator import DSparkSpeculator
+
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    w1 = torch.randn(VOCAB, RANK, generator=g, device="cuda").to(base.dtype)
+    w2 = (torch.randn(VOCAB, RANK, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.05).to(base.dtype)
+    s = DSparkSpeculator.__new__(DSparkSpeculator)
+    s.model = SimpleNamespace(
+        model=SimpleNamespace(
+            markov_head=SimpleNamespace(markov_w1=SimpleNamespace(weight=w1))
+        ),
+        compute_draft_logits=lambda h: base,
+        markov_embed=lambda ids: F.embedding(ids, w1),
+        markov_bias=lambda e: F.linear(e, w2),
+    )
+    s.num_speculative_steps, s.temperature = N_SPEC, temps
+    s._draft_topk = s.acceptance_estimator = s.draft_watermarker = None
+    s._d2t_scatter_index, s.use_confidence_head, s.use_fp64_gumbel = None, False, False
+    cache = torch.zeros(REQS, N_SPEC, VOCAB, dtype=base.dtype, device="cuda")
+    s.draft_logits = SimpleNamespace(values=cache, row_mapping=None)
+    s.seeds = torch.randint(0, 2**62, (REQS,), device="cuda")
+    s._step_cols = torch.arange(N_SPEC, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    s.sample_indices = torch.arange(REQS * N_SPEC, device="cuda")
+    s.sample_idx_mapping = torch.randperm(REQS, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    s.sample_idx_mapping = s.sample_idx_mapping.repeat_interleave(N_SPEC)
+    s.sample_pos = torch.arange(REQS * N_SPEC, device="cuda") + 1000
+    ids = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (REQS * N_SPEC,), generator=g, device="cuda")
+    s.input_buffers = SimpleNamespace(input_ids=ids)
+    s._anchor_idx = torch.arange(REQS, device="cuda") * N_SPEC
+    s.draft_tokens = torch.zeros(REQS, N_SPEC, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+    hidden = torch.empty(REQS * N_SPEC, 1, device="cuda")
+    if fused:
+        with torch.device("cuda"):
+            sampler = FusedMarkovSampler(REQS, VOCAB, RANK, base.dtype)
+        assert sampler(s, REQS, hidden)
+    else:
+        DSparkSpeculator._sample_sequential(s, REQS, hidden)
+    return s.draft_tokens, cache, s.sample_idx_mapping[::N_SPEC]
+
+
+def test_greedy_and_cache_match_loop():
+    base = (torch.randn(REQS * N_SPEC, VOCAB, device="cuda") * 3).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    temps = torch.tensor([0.0, 1.0], device="cuda").repeat(REQS // 2)
+    ref_tok, ref_cache, slots = _sample(False, temps, base, 1)
+    tok, cache, _ = _sample(True, temps, base, 1)
+    greedy = temps[slots] == 0
+    assert torch.equal(tok[greedy], ref_tok[greedy])
+    assert torch.equal(cache[temps == 0], ref_cache[temps == 0])
+    # Sampled requests draw other tokens than Gumbel-max, so only step 0 agrees.
+    assert torch.equal(cache[:, 0], ref_cache[:, 0])
+
+
+def test_sampled_tokens_follow_softmax():
+    temp = 0.6
+    row = (torch.randn(VOCAB, device="cuda") * 3).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    base = row.expand(REQS * N_SPEC, VOCAB).contiguous()
+    temps = torch.full((REQS,), temp, device="cuda")
+    counts = torch.zeros(VOCAB, device="cuda")
+    expected = torch.zeros(VOCAB, device="cuda")
+    for seed in range(40):
+        tok, cache, slots = _sample(True, temps, base, seed)
+        counts += torch.bincount(tok[:, 0], minlength=VOCAB)
+        expected += torch.softmax(cache[slots, 0].float() / temp, -1).sum(0)
+    n = counts.sum()
+    top = expected.topk(10).indices
+    p = expected[top] / n
+    z = (counts[top] / n - p) / (p * (1 - p) / n).sqrt()
+    assert z.abs().max() < 5, z

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DSpark's sequential Markov sampling as the bias GEMM plus two kernels a step.
+Tokens are drawn by inverse CDF of softmax(cached logits / temperature), one exp
+per logit instead of Gumbel-max's hash and two logs; temperature 0 is argmax."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import LOG2E, tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import (
+    _DRAFT_NOISE_SALT,
+    murmur3_uniform32,
+    spec_step_seed,
+)
+
+_BLOCK_SIZE = 2048
+_LOG2E = tl.constexpr(LOG2E)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["step"])
+def _markov_sample_kernel(
+    base_logits_ptr,  # [num_reqs * NUM_STEPS, VOCAB], rows ordered (req, step)
+    base_logits_stride,
+    bias_ptr,  # [num_reqs, VOCAB]
+    bias_stride,
+    step,
+    idx_mapping_ptr,
+    temp_ptr,
+    cache_ptr,  # [max_num_reqs, NUM_STEPS, VOCAB], contiguous
+    partial_max_ptr,  # [max_num_reqs, BLOCK_P]
+    partial_sum_ptr,
+    NUM_STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    VOCAB: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_P: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    block_idx = tl.program_id(1)
+    block = block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    mask = block < VOCAB
+    row = req * NUM_STEPS + step
+    base = tl.load(
+        base_logits_ptr + row * base_logits_stride + block,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    )
+    bias = tl.load(bias_ptr + req * bias_stride + block, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    # Rounded once to the cache dtype, as the loop's base_logits + bias.
+    logits = (base.to(tl.float32) + bias.to(tl.float32)).to(cache_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+
+    req_state_idx = tl.load(idx_mapping_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    is_valid = req_state_idx >= 0
+    cache_row = cache_ptr + (req_state_idx * NUM_STEPS + step) * VOCAB
+    tl.store(cache_row + block, logits, mask=mask & is_valid)
+    temp = tl.load(temp_ptr + req_state_idx, mask=is_valid, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    logits = logits.to(tl.float32)
+    out = req * BLOCK_P + block_idx
+    if temp != 0.0:
+        scaled = logits * (_LOG2E / temp)
+        block_max = tl.max(scaled, axis=0)
+        tl.store(partial_max_ptr + out, block_max)
+        tl.store(partial_sum_ptr + out, tl.sum(tl.exp2(scaled - block_max), axis=0))
+    else:
+        value, idx = tl.max(logits, axis=0, return_indices=True)
+        tl.store(partial_max_ptr + out, value)
+        # Temperature 0 keeps the block's argmax in partial_sum (exact below 2^24).
+        tl.store(partial_sum_ptr + out, (block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + idx).to(tl.float32))
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["step"])
+def _markov_select_kernel(
+    step,
+    idx_mapping_ptr,
+    sample_pos_ptr,
+    temp_ptr,
+    seeds_ptr,
+    cache_ptr,
+    draft_tokens_ptr,
+    draft_tokens_stride,
+    embed_weight_ptr,  # [VOCAB, RANK] markov_w1
+    embed_ptr,  # [max_num_reqs, RANK], the next step's bias GEMM input
+    partial_max_ptr,
+    partial_sum_ptr,
+    NUM_STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    VOCAB: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_P: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    row = req * NUM_STEPS + step
+    req_state_idx = tl.load(idx_mapping_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    is_valid = req_state_idx >= 0
+    temp = tl.load(temp_ptr + req_state_idx, mask=is_valid, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    p = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_P)
+    p_mask = p < tl.cdiv(VOCAB, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    values = tl.load(
+        partial_max_ptr + req * BLOCK_P + p, mask=p_mask, other=-float("inf")
+    )
+    sums = tl.load(partial_sum_ptr + req * BLOCK_P + p, mask=p_mask, other=0.0)
+    if temp != 0.0:
+        seed = spec_step_seed(
+            tl.load(seeds_ptr + req_state_idx, mask=is_valid, other=0), step
+        )
+        # Keyed by the position before the predicted token, as gumbel_sample.
+        pos = tl.load(sample_pos_ptr + row) - 1 + _DRAFT_NOISE_SALT
+        top = tl.max(values, axis=0)
+        mass = tl.where(sums > 0, sums * tl.exp2(values - top), 0.0)
+        cum = tl.cumsum(mass, axis=0)
+        target = murmur3_uniform32(seed, pos, tl.full((), VOCAB, tl.int32)) * tl.sum(
+            mass, axis=0
+        )
+        # A rounding overshoot past the last block takes the last nonzero one.
+        last = tl.max(tl.where(mass > 0, p, 0), axis=0)
+        blk = tl.minimum(tl.sum((cum <= target).to(tl.int32)), last)
+        at_blk = p == blk
+        blk_max = tl.sum(tl.where(at_blk, values, 0.0))
+        # The mass left inside the block, in units of its own weights.
+        target = (target - tl.sum(tl.where(at_blk, cum - mass, 0.0))) * tl.exp2(
+            top - blk_max
+        )
+        i = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+        offs = blk * BLOCK_SIZE + i
+        cache_row = cache_ptr + (req_state_idx * NUM_STEPS + step) * VOCAB
+        cached = tl.load(
+            cache_row + offs, mask=(offs < VOCAB) & is_valid, other=-float("inf")
+        )
+        # The same fp32 weights _markov_sample_kernel summed for this block.
+        weights = tl.exp2(cached.to(tl.float32) * (_LOG2E / temp) - blk_max)
+        last_tok = tl.max(tl.where(weights > 0, i, 0), axis=0)
+        idx = tl.sum((tl.cumsum(weights, axis=0) <= target).to(tl.int32))
+        token = (blk * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.minimum(idx, last_tok)).to(tl.int64)
+    else:
+        winner = tl.argmax(values, axis=0, tie_break_left=True)
+        token = tl.sum(tl.where(p == winner, sums, 0.0)).to(tl.int64)
+    tl.store(draft_tokens_ptr + req * draft_tokens_stride + step, token)
+    r = tl.arange(0, RANK)
+    tl.store(embed_ptr + req * RANK + r, tl.load(embed_weight_ptr + token * RANK + r))
+
+
+class FusedMarkovSampler:
+    """``DSparkSpeculator._sample_sequential``'s hook. Its scratch is allocated
+    at model init, so CUDA graphs keep the addresses."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, max_num_reqs: int, vocab_size: int, rank: int, dtype: torch.dtype
+    ):
+        assert rank & (rank - 1) == 0, rank
+        self.vocab_size, self.rank = vocab_size, rank
+        self.num_blocks = triton.cdiv(vocab_size, _BLOCK_SIZE)
+        self.block_p = triton.next_power_of_2(self.num_blocks)
+        self.markov_embed = torch.empty(max_num_reqs, rank, dtype=dtype)
+        self.partial_max = torch.empty(max_num_reqs, self.block_p, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.partial_sum = torch.empty_like(self.partial_max)
+
+    def __call__(self, spec, num_reqs: int, head_hidden: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        model, n_spec = spec.model, spec.num_speculative_steps
+        base_logits = model.compute_draft_logits(
+            head_hidden[spec.sample_indices[: num_reqs * n_spec]]
+        )
+        markov_embed = model.markov_embed(
+            spec.input_buffers.input_ids[spec._anchor_idx[:num_reqs]]
+        )
+        consts = dict(
+            NUM_STEPS=n_spec,
+            VOCAB=self.vocab_size,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=_BLOCK_SIZE,
+            BLOCK_P=self.block_p,
+        )
+        for step in range(n_spec):
+            bias = model.markov_bias(markov_embed)
+            _markov_sample_kernel[(num_reqs, self.num_blocks)](
+                base_logits,
+                base_logits.stride(0),
+                bias,
+                bias.stride(0),
+                step,
+                spec.sample_idx_mapping,
+                spec.temperature,
+                spec.draft_logits.values,
+                self.partial_max,
+                self.partial_sum,
+                **consts,
+                num_warps=2,
+            )
+            _markov_select_kernel[(num_reqs,)](
+                step,
+                spec.sample_idx_mapping,
+                spec.sample_pos,
+                spec.temperature,
+                spec.seeds,
+                spec.draft_logits.values,
+                spec.draft_tokens,
+                spec.draft_tokens.stride(0),
+                model.model.markov_head.markov_w1.weight,
+                self.markov_embed,
+                self.partial_max,
+                self.partial_sum,
+                RANK=self.rank,
+                **consts,
+            )
+            markov_embed = self.markov_embed[:num_reqs]
+        return True
